full_page.content:
Page 61 Cont.
April Thanks Eugene Duchaine - 19 - broken pelvis Enrolled in S. Mass A. and prayed for ... now a soldier ...
Mrs. V. Rich - Jewiss - 42 - phlebitis from child .. birth .... Enrol- led Today promised perpetual
Wilburn Pugh - 27 - in Receiving Hospital - hopeless heart trouble - has wife and one little child.
Dominic Simon - 25 - epyleptic ... hard to handle.
Page 62 April Baby Thomas A. Soloman - 5 mo. - blind - cateracts seems to see just a little ... good Serian People ....
Mrs. Nonie Russell - 55 - asks for prayers that husband and one son who have dropped religion come back to faith and reason.
Bernard Mason - 4 - Eye infection quite threatening.
Joseph Lilly - 23 - principal support of mother and large family of dependents .... fears on this acc't to be drafted.
Apr. 23
Verdun Hayter - Episcopelian - 27 - Flu ten days ago - now become pneumonia - 107 fever - Enrolled as a perpetual member 9:30 P.M. June 2 - Here Tonight in perfect health - went back to work yester- day - P.S. Drs had feared at Ist to tell them the fever was more than 106 - when actually it was 107.
Jackie Parpart - 42 - a beautiful boy till 21 months old - then come infantile paralisis ....
Mich. Kennedy - to help wife and child wants middle aged woman - see note book.
Mrs. Schemansky - 60 severel slight strokes - now unable to talk ...
Page 63 Apr. 27 Mrs. Pearl Root - 49 - lutheran - fearfully swollen arm and for nine weeks almost unbearably painful. Drs rather at sea, propose drastic measures and treatment. Enrolled % phone this p.m. and is here still in great pain 7:30 P.M. 29th phoned Today has been sleeping fine since.
Apr. 29th Susan M. Ash of Royal Oak - 58 - ostamelitis - her twin sister also from R. Oak and 58 broken knee-cap ...
